name: Barbell power clean
cue: Floor to shoulders, receive above parallel.

name: Barbell hang squat clean
cue: From above the knee, pull under into a full front squat.

name: Barbell push jerk
cue: Dip, drive, and drop under the bar into a partial squat, stand to finish.

name: Squat clean thruster
cue: Clean from the floor into a full squat and drive straight into a thruster.

name: Barbell step-up
cue: Bar on the back, whole foot on the box, drive through the front leg.

name: Barbell farmers carry
cue: Carry a barbell by the centre in one hand, or one in each hand, tall and braced.

name: Barbell overhead walk
cue: Bar locked out overhead, ribs down, walk with short steps.

name: Dumbbell hang squat clean
cue: Dumbbells at the hang, pull under into a full squat, stand.

name: Dumbbell squat clean
cue: Dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders, receive in a full squat.

name: Dumbbell hang split snatch
cue: From the hang, snatch overhead while splitting the feet, alternate feet.

name: Dumbbell deadlift
cue: Dumbbells outside the feet, flat back, stand tall.

name: Dumbbell burpee deadlift
cue: Burpee with hands on the dumbbells, stand up into a deadlift.

name: Dumbbell farmers carry
cue: One dumbbell in each hand, tall posture, quick steps.

name: Dumbbell waiters walk
cue: One dumbbell locked out overhead, walk with the ribs down.

name: Kettlebell thruster
cue: Bells in the rack, squat and drive them overhead in one movement.

name: Kettlebell walking lunge
cue: Two bells at the sides or in the rack, long steps, back knee to the floor.

name: Weighted pull-up
cue: Dumbbell between the feet or belt, dead hang to chin over the bar.

name: L pull-up
cue: Legs held straight out in front, pull chin over the bar.

name: Bar muscle-up
cue: Pull high, roll over the bar, press to support.

name: Toes-to-bar
cue: Hang, swing and bring both feet to touch the bar.

name: Knees-to-elbows
cue: Hang, bring the knees up to touch the elbows.

name: Hand-release push-up
cue: Chest to the floor, lift the hands, press back up.

name: Burpee pull-up
cue: Burpee, then jump to the bar and do a pull-up.

name: Burpee box jump
cue: Burpee, then jump onto the box.

name: Burpee box jump over
cue: Burpee, jump onto and over the box.

name: Burpee muscle-up
cue: Burpee, then jump to the rings or bar and do a muscle-up.

name: Bear crawl
cue: Hands and feet on the floor, knees just off the ground, crawl forward.

name: Flutter kicks
cue: On the back, legs straight, small alternating kicks; 4 kicks = 1 rep.

name: Ball slam
cue: Ball overhead, slam it to the floor, pick it up and repeat.

name: Rope climb
cue: Climb to the 15-ft mark, wrap the feet, descend under control.

name: Ring row
cue: Body straight, pull the chest to the rings.

name: Ring push-up
cue: Push-up with hands on the rings, stabilise, chest to ring height.

name: Inverted hang lower
cue: From an inverted hang on the rings, lower slowly with straight body and arms.

name: GHD sit-up
cue: On the GHD, extend back and touch the floor, sit up to touch the pads.

name: Back extension
cue: On the GHD, hinge down and extend the back to horizontal.

name: Plate carry
cue: Carry a plate at the chest or overhead for distance.

name: Plate overhead walking lunge
cue: Plate locked out overhead, walking lunges.

name: Sandbag carry
cue: Sandbag on the shoulder or in the arms, walk or run for distance.

name: Sandbag ground-to-over-shoulder
cue: Lift the sandbag from the floor and throw it over the shoulder.

name: Shoulder to overhead
cue: Bar from the shoulders to lockout overhead any way: strict press, push press or jerk.

name: Barbell overhead walking lunge
cue: Bar locked out overhead, long steps, back knee touches, arms stay straight.

name: Barbell front-rack lunge
cue: Bar in the front rack, elbows high, step long and touch the back knee, drive up through the front foot.

name: Strict pull-up
cue: Dead hang, no kip, pull the chin over the bar and lower under control.

name: Standing broad jump
cue: Two-foot take-off and landing, swing the arms, jump as far as you can each rep.

name: Forward roll
cue: Tuck the chin, roll over the upper back and stand up without using the hands.

name: Wall climb
cue: Feet on the wall, walk the hands back until the chest touches the wall, then walk back out.

name: Bar hang
cue: Hang from the pull-up bar with straight arms; grip is the whole exercise.

name: Box step-up
cue: Whole foot on the box, stand tall on top, step down and alternate legs.

name: Hanging hip touch
cue: Hang from the bar, swing the legs up and touch one hip to the bar, alternate sides.

name: Weighted box step-up
cue: Ruck, weighted pack or vest on, whole foot on the box, stand tall on top, alternate legs.

name: Sled push
cue: Arms straight or bent, lean into the sled and drive with short quick steps.

name: Sled pull (arm over arm)
cue: Sit or brace, pull the rope hand over hand until the sled reaches you.

name: Medicine-ball clean
cue: Ball from the floor, extend the hips, pull under into a squat with the ball at the chest and stand.

name: Partner carry
cue: Fireman's carry, piggyback or partner barbell carry over the distance; swap halfway if you like.

name: Single-arm kettlebell overhead squat
cue: Bell locked out overhead in one hand, squat below parallel keeping the bell over mid-foot.

name: Kettlebell clean and jerk
cue: Swing the bell into the rack, then dip and drive it overhead to lockout.

name: Double kettlebell front-rack lunge
cue: Two bells in the rack, elbows in, step long and touch the back knee.

name: Double kettlebell front-rack carry
cue: Two bells in the rack, ribs down, walk tall.

name: Double kettlebell overhead carry
cue: Two bells locked out overhead, biceps by the ears, walk without leaning back.

name: Dumbbell split clean
cue: Clean two dumbbells to the shoulders while landing in a split stance; alternate the lead leg.

name: Dumbbell squat clean thruster
cue: Clean two dumbbells into a full squat and drive straight into a press overhead.

name: Dumbbell front squat
cue: Dumbbells on the shoulders, elbows forward, squat below parallel and stand.

name: Dumbbell hang clean and jerk
cue: From the hang, clean two dumbbells to the shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.

name: Shuttle run
cue: Sprint out to the mark, touch and sprint back; one rep is out and back.
